coinmotion: Coinmotion provides cryptocurrency buying, selling, and storage services for individuals and businesses. Its products include recurring purchases, an OTC trading desk, and an API for connecting accounts to other services.
pdax: PDAX is a digital asset trading platform serving the Philippines. Its app provides access to cryptocurrencies, government bonds, and digital collectibles, with local cash-in and cash-out options.
foxbit: Foxbit is a Brazilian cryptocurrency platform for individuals and businesses. It offers crypto trading, digital dollar services, international transfers, and a card for spending crypto balances.
finoa: Finoa develops technology infrastructure that helps businesses participate in the onchain economy. Its infrastructure work includes blockchain and staking services; regulated financial services are handled by separately licensed entities.
taurus: Taurus builds digital asset infrastructure for banks and other financial institutions. Its platform combines custody, tokenization, trading, and collateral management for cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities, and digital currencies.
xrex: XREX Group provides cross-border payment and cryptocurrency exchange services. It builds blockchain-based financial services for businesses and individuals.
finst: Finst is a cryptocurrency exchange based in Amsterdam. Its platform offers crypto trading and investment bundles with monthly rebalancing, alongside tools for managing digital asset investments.
breet: Breet provides cryptocurrency buying, selling, swapping, and cash-out services in Nigeria and Ghana. Businesses can use its crypto payment API, invoice tools, and OTC trading desk.
bit2me: Bit2Me is a Spanish cryptocurrency platform for individuals, companies, and institutions. Its products include a crypto broker, wallet, trading tools, a payment card, and tax reports, with services for buying, selling, storing, sending, and receiving digital assets.
honeycoin: HoneyCoin builds payment and treasury infrastructure for businesses operating across borders, including African markets. Its platform combines multi-currency wallets, virtual accounts, stablecoin conversion, and local payment collection and payouts.
dunamu: Dunamu develops digital asset and securities services in South Korea. Its products include the Upbit cryptocurrency exchange and the Stockplus investment platforms, alongside blockchain services.
21bitcoin: 21bitcoin provides an app for buying, saving, and holding Bitcoin. Users can make recurring purchases and choose between custody through the service and transfers to their own wallets.
aquanow: Aquanow provides digital asset infrastructure and liquidity for financial institutions. Its services support digital asset brokerage, trading, and stablecoin payments through APIs, platforms, and OTC execution.
bison: BISON is a cryptocurrency trading platform powered by the Boerse Stuttgart Group. Its app and website let users buy, sell, and hold Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.
bitbank: bitbank operates a cryptocurrency exchange in Japan. It provides yen-denominated spot trading, crypto lending, and APIs for market data and trading, with additional services for business customers.
bitcoin-suisse: Bitcoin Suisse provides crypto finance services for individuals, corporations, and crypto organizations. Its product suite includes trading, staking, custody, and lending with dedicated client support.
bitmama: Bitmama provides a platform for buying, selling, and managing cryptocurrencies. Its services also include crypto payment cards and transfers of fiat money and digital assets.
bitnovo: Bitnovo provides cryptocurrency buying, selling, and swapping services, with a self-custodial wallet. Its business products include crypto payment acceptance, on-ramp integrations, an OTC desk, and APIs.
cashlink: Cashlink builds infrastructure for issuing and settling token-based securities. It provides a token-based registry and services for issuers, brokers, and financial institutions moving capital-market processes onto distributed ledgers.
change: Change operates a multi-asset trading app that combines cryptocurrency investing with contracts for difference on stocks, foreign exchange, indices, and commodities. Users can manage these products through one platform.
coincash: CoinCash is a Hungarian cryptocurrency broker offering online buying, selling, and asset management. It also operates a Bitcoin ATM network and provides tailored services for larger investors.
coincorner: CoinCorner provides Bitcoin buying, selling, storage, and payment services for individuals and businesses. Its products include recurring Bitcoin purchases, international transfers, custody, and the Lightning-enabled Bolt Card.
coinext: Coinext is a Brazilian cryptocurrency trading platform. It provides buying and selling, crypto storage and transfers, staking, and deposits and withdrawals in Brazilian reais through Pix.
coinfinity: Coinfinity is a Bitcoin broker with an app and web portal for buying, selling, and saving in Bitcoin. Its products include recurring savings plans, an integrated wallet, and Bitcoin purchases through Lightning.
deblock: Deblock combines a euro current account with a self-custody cryptocurrency wallet. Its app includes an IBAN, a Visa card, SEPA transfers, and tools for using euros and digital assets.
double-jump-tokyo: double jump.tokyo builds enterprise Web3 infrastructure for authentication and payments. Its work includes corporate wallets, stablecoin and AI-agent payments, and cryptocurrency accounting. Its products include the N Suite enterprise wallet, RIKYU crypto accounting software, and Wallet Engine.
flitpay: Flitpay is a cryptocurrency exchange serving India. Its platform lets users buy and sell Bitcoin and other digital assets in Indian rupees and transfer cryptocurrencies between platforms.
fomo-pay: FOMO Pay provides digital payment and financial services for merchants, corporations, and financial institutions. Its products include payment collection, global payouts, multi-currency virtual accounts, and treasury services.
fuze: Fuze builds digital asset payment and wealth infrastructure for banks, fintechs, and other businesses. Its platform supports stablecoin orchestration, cross-border payments, crypto payment acceptance, trading, and wallets.
ginco: Ginco develops blockchain infrastructure and tools for businesses building Web3 services. Its products include an enterprise crypto wallet, wallet monitoring tools, a blockchain cloud platform, and a self-custodial mobile wallet.
hata: Hata operates a cryptocurrency exchange that connects fiat money with digital assets. Its platform offers crypto buying, selling, trading, staking, and portfolio tracking.
koinx: KoinX develops cryptocurrency tax, accounting, and portfolio tracking software. Its tools help investors, businesses, and tax professionals calculate liabilities, produce reports, and manage digital asset transactions.
lemon: Lemon provides a digital wallet for payments, transfers, and cryptocurrency investing. Its app combines peso and digital dollar balances with Bitcoin access, investment products, and payment card features.
liminal-custody: Liminal provides institutional cryptocurrency custody and wallet infrastructure for banks, exchanges, and digital asset businesses. Its API-driven tools support wallet management, transaction governance, automated refills, and asset consolidation.
midchains: MidChains provides digital asset infrastructure for institutions and corporate customers. Its services focus on trade execution, corporate treasury, and cross-border settlement and payment flows.
mt-pelerin: Mt Pelerin provides tools for buying, selling, and swapping cryptocurrencies in self-custody. Its services include wallet-linked IBANs, crypto-funded bank transfers, and an OTC desk for larger trades.
nbx: NBX is a Norwegian cryptocurrency exchange supporting trading in Norwegian kroner. Its products include Bitcoin and other digital assets, tokenized metals, recurring investment tools, OTC trading, and custody.
netcoins: Netcoins provides cryptocurrency trading services in Canada. Its platform includes instant trades, limit orders, portfolio tools, and staking, with funding through Interac e-transfers, bank wires, and crypto deposits.
paymium: Paymium is a French platform for buying, selling, and managing cryptocurrencies. It serves individuals and businesses with recurring purchases, Bitcoin savings plans, and an OTC service for larger transactions.
relai: Relai provides a Bitcoin savings app built around self-custody. Users can buy Bitcoin and manage their own private keys rather than leaving their holdings under the app provider's control.
safello: Safello is a Swedish cryptocurrency brokerage. Its platform offers crypto trading, automatic savings, and wallet storage, with BankID login and Swish payments.
sbi-vc-trade: SBI VC Trade provides cryptocurrency trading services in Japan. Its products include spot and leveraged trading, crypto lending, recurring purchases, staking, and services for corporate customers.
tangany: Tangany provides digital asset custody infrastructure for banks, brokers, and financial institutions. Its white-label platform includes API-based wallet services and a core crypto system for integrating digital assets into financial products.
waltio: Waltio develops cryptocurrency tax reporting software. It aggregates transactions from exchanges, wallets, and blockchains to help users organize their activity and prepare tax reports.
zumo: Zumo provides embedded digital asset infrastructure for companies offering crypto products in the UK. Its platform supports custody, trading, customer onboarding, and localized compliance processes for financial institutions and crypto businesses.
swissquote: Swissquote is a digital banking and online trading group. It offers banking and investment services across securities, currencies, derivatives, and cryptocurrencies.
ankr: Ankr provides blockchain infrastructure for developers and businesses. Its products include multichain RPC and API access, rollup and sidechain development services, and staking integrations.
applied-blockchain: Applied Blockchain designs and builds digital asset applications, AI systems, and privacy-preserving infrastructure. Its services include blockchain strategy, tokenization, smart contract development and review, and integration support for regulated industries.
arcus: Arcus develops a self-custodial decentralized exchange on Robinhood Chain. Its platform focuses on tokenized stock trading and perpetual derivatives with around-the-clock market access.
argus-labs: Argus Labs develops games and infrastructure for onchain game worlds. Its World Engine SDK uses a sharded rollup architecture to let developers build scalable, EVM-compatible blockchains for games.
arrakis-finance: Arrakis Finance provides automated, non-custodial market making for token issuers. Its tools manage onchain liquidity for project tokens, tokenized real-world assets, and equities across decentralized trading venues.
auros: Auros is a proprietary cryptocurrency trading firm and liquidity provider. It combines algorithmic trading infrastructure with market-making services and support for token launches and liquidity strategy.
axiom: Axiom develops zero-knowledge proving infrastructure for developers. Its products include the modular OpenVM virtual machine and the Axiom Proving API for generating proofs of program execution.
bitaccess: Bitaccess builds blockchain software for fintech businesses. Its products include Bitcoin ATM technology and the Catena suite for publishing and managing datasets on public or private blockchains.
bitonic: Bitonic provides Bitcoin buying, selling, and storage services. Its app supports target-price orders and recurring investment plans, with options to use a Bitonic account or a personal wallet.
bluefin: Bluefin develops an onchain financial platform on Sui. Its decentralized trading infrastructure supports spot markets and derivatives.
bob: BOB builds Bitcoin-focused decentralized finance infrastructure. Its platform connects Bitcoin and Ethereum ecosystems with tools for swaps, saving, earning, and borrowing.
boost: Boost provides tools for running token incentive campaigns tied to onchain actions. Teams can fund rewards, distribute campaigns through Farcaster, World, or the web, and measure campaign results.
bullish: Bullish operates a cryptocurrency exchange focused on institutional trading. Its platform combines spot and derivatives markets with an order book and automated market-making infrastructure.
dialectic: Dialectic combines machine intelligence with crypto-native financial infrastructure. Its work includes agentic DeFi, automated yield strategies, and deep-technology venture investing.
eco: Eco builds stablecoin infrastructure for moving money across blockchains and digital asset markets. Its products include routing tools and shared liquidity infrastructure for developers, enterprises, and DeFi applications.
hype: Hype is an agency serving cryptocurrency and emerging technology companies. Its work covers communications and brand storytelling, talent recruitment, and practical AI systems for business operations.
injective-labs: Injective Labs is a research and development company building Web3 infrastructure and financial applications. It contributes to the Injective blockchain and products such as the Helix decentralized exchange.
institute-of-free-technology: The Institute of Free Technology is a startup studio supporting public-goods technology and digital civil liberties. It provides technical, financial, legal, and operational support to projects including Logos, Status, Keycard, and Nimbus.
intellecteu: IntellectEU builds technology for digital finance and payment systems. Its work includes financial infrastructure integration and distributed-ledger solutions for businesses and financial institutions.
kappa-lab: Kappa Lab is a digital asset market maker. It uses proprietary trading infrastructure and algorithms to provide liquidity and pricing across cryptocurrency exchanges and blockchain ecosystems.
legend: Legend provides a mobile app for accessing decentralized finance. Users can trade digital assets, borrow, and access onchain yield strategies from the same application.
lisk: Lisk develops a workspace for businesses managing money across bank accounts, wallets, and stablecoin rails. Its current product brings accounts, payments, portfolios, and approvals together for finance teams.
makina: Makina develops DeFi execution and vault infrastructure for onchain strategies. Its platform lets users access yield strategies managed by professional operators and supports asset managers and protocol treasuries.
n1: N1 develops a layer-one blockchain built for trading. Its network includes native order-book and margining infrastructure, with an exchange offering perpetual futures.
nimbus: Nimbus develops lightweight Ethereum clients for solo stakers and other node operators. Its tools include a consensus client, a verified Web3 proxy, and a Portal client for accessing Ethereum data.
optimism-foundation: The Optimism Foundation supports the Optimism ecosystem and its Ethereum layer-two infrastructure. Optimism's OP Stack provides tools for building customizable layer-two chains and applications.
qcp-capital: QCP provides digital asset trading and investment services for institutional, professional, and accredited investors. Its offerings include spot trading, derivatives, structured solutions, and asset management.
quantstamp: Quantstamp provides blockchain and Web3 security services. It reviews smart contracts, layer-one protocols, and web infrastructure and provides incident-response support.
the-better-money-company: The Better Money Company builds infrastructure for stablecoin transfers and swaps. Its clearinghouse connects money businesses through a shared endpoint with defined pricing and settlement terms.
trilitech: Trilitech develops technology and applications for the Tezos blockchain. Its team works on core protocol development, application adoption, and support for builders, startups, and artists in the Tezos ecosystem.
usual: Usual develops a stablecoin protocol that uses tokenized real-world assets. Its infrastructure connects stablecoin products with governance and mechanisms for distributing value to participants through the USUAL token.
veefriends: VeeFriends is a character and entertainment brand created by Gary Vaynerchuk. Its universe spans animated series, trading card games, digital collectibles, comics, and physical merchandise.
violet: Violet builds blockchain-native identity and compliance infrastructure for DeFi. Its tools include reusable onchain identity signals, anti-money-laundering checks, geofencing, and Sybil-resistance services.
zenledger: ZenLedger develops tax reporting software for cryptocurrency, DeFi, and NFT transactions. It offers tools for individual investors and tax professionals, alongside enterprise blockchain analytics services.
zircuit: Zircuit develops onchain financial infrastructure and applications. Its products include a finance app with digital asset yield strategies and a liquidity hub for liquid staking and restaking tokens.
